import random, sys, time, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
POW3=main.POW3
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)

def build(m, k, dense=True):
    """k-tree style graph: order 0..m-1, each var attached to a k-clique of later vars."""
    later=[[] for _ in range(m)]
    clique=set()
    for i in range(m-1,-1,-1):
        cand=list(range(i+1,m)); rng.shuffle(cand)
        best=[]
        for c in cand:
            if all((min(x,c),max(x,c)) in clique for x in best):
                best.append(c)
                if len(best)==k: break
        later[i]=best
        for a in range(len(best)):
            for b in range(a+1,len(best)):
                clique.add((min(best[a],best[b]),max(best[a],best[b])))
    factors=[]
    for i in range(m):
        pool=[i]+later[i]
        nf = 1 if not dense else rng.randint(1,2)
        for _ in range(nf):
            extra=[x for x in pool if x!=i and rng.random()<0.9]
            scope=tuple(sorted([i]+extra))
            size=POW3[len(scope)]
            tab=[rng.randint(1,1000000) if rng.random()>0.05 else 0 for _ in range(size)]
            factors.append((scope,tab))
    return factors, list(range(m))

for m,k in ((64,4),(64,4),(48,4),(64,2)):
    factors, order = build(m,k)
    red=main.reduce_factors(factors)
    print("m",m,"k",k,"factors",len(factors),"scopes",sorted(set(len(s) for s,_ in factors)))
    t0=time.perf_counter(); Z,marg=main.infer_joint(red,order,m); t1=time.perf_counter()
    print("  Z bits",Z.bit_length(),"jt time %.3f"%(t1-t0))
    ok=all(sum(marg[v])==Z for v in range(m))
    print("  sum check", ok)
    if m<=24:
        t2=time.perf_counter(); mn=main.naive_marginals(red,order,m); t3=time.perf_counter()
        print("  naive time %.3f"%(t3-t2), "equal", mn==marg)
EOF
